title.zh: DAOs are forcing crypto protocols to choose between code and emergency brakes

current_state.zh: Compound's Proposal 289 nearly transferred $24 million in COMP due to a late voting surge, exposing how DAO governance rules can be exploited and prompting debates on emergency brakes versus code immutability.
